senses.gloss: beshani, name of a species of olives.
units: Peah VII, 1 an olive called ב׳ … (Ms. M. ביי׳) beshani. Y. ib. 20ᵃ top אית דבעי מימר ב׳ ממש וכ׳ some would say, it means really a beshani (named after Beshan), others would derive its name from the fact (v. בּוֹשׁ) that it shames its neighbor (trees by its richness). [Oth. opin. a dry olive, not used for manufacturing oil.]
